limits: Both native processes and their 9/12 test suites pass. Native image parity is not tested; Fyrox CPU render seconds and frame/submission intervals are not GPU execution timing.

Both WebGL2 software browser variants pass 38/38 checks plus 16/16 ordinary lifecycle checks across six scenes, with 52,719 exact sampled ID centers and 15,167 ownerless occlusion centers each. This qualifies only the reported hosted software smoke scope.

WebGPU has 15 ordinary screenshot failures plus 2 aggregate diagnostic failures. Its 16 ordinary lifecycle checks pass. Capture dimensions and full-page crop assertions pass; the presentation gate remains failed.
Six direct engine-canvas ID snapshots pass all 52,719 exact sampled centers; this does not establish ordinary page presentation or engine-wide color parity.

Only three of twelve actual GPU texture copies complete. Full2D32 color meets every unchanged color threshold and its ID copy has zero mismatches. Full2D64 raw color has no physical color oracle; nine other reads time out at an unidentified stage.
The isolated clear has correct GPU mapped and canvas-snapshot bytes but a page screenshot containing only background. The specific browser/compositor cause remains unproven.

Physical desktop/mobile devices, Safari/iPhone/iPad/Android, representative production assets, performance targets and asynchronous engine picking remain pending. Interactive selection remains the generation-checked CPU reference.

Synthetic fixture v2 separates the all-pose mannequin footprints. Existing coplanar source-depth regressions and exact ID/color thresholds were not weakened. No renderer is selected or globally qualified.
